newsitem.title: USA: Charter One to acquire Haverfield.
newsitem.headline: Charter One to acquire Haverfield.

text.p: Charter One Financial Inc and Haverfield Corp said Wednesday they had reached a definitive agreement to merge in a stock swap valued at $53.7 million.
Terms call for a tax-free exchange of $27 of Charter stock for each Haverfield share. The pricing reflects 180 percent of Haverfield's book value as of March 31, the companies said.
The deal is expected to close in the third quarter.
Charter closed at 42-1/2 Tuesday, while Haverfield closed at 23-1/2.
Charter said the effect of the merger on Haverfield's workforce would be minimal. It said it expects cost savings that will have an immediate accretive effect on earnings.
Charter One is the holding company for Charter One Bank, with $14 billion in assets. Haverfield is the holding company for Home Bank, with $342 million in assets.
